harness.col.name: Harness
harness.caption: Supported harnesses with ids
harness.note.sessions: One event per session, not per turn: the harness stores only a per-session cumulative total. Skopli still includes sessions whose totals are marked estimated.
harness.note.estimated: Token counts are estimated from stored message length (about four characters per token). Treat these totals as estimates, not billed usage.
harness.note.perModel: One event per model per session: the harness stores real provider counts per model, not per turn. Skopli reads every session regardless of its billing state.

site.homeTitle: Skopli: price what your coding agents spend, from their local logs
site.homeDescription: An open-source SDK that reads the session logs of 40 coding-agent harnesses, rolls them up, and prices them against market catalogs. 9 languages, one Rust core, no account, no telemetry.
home.h1: A ledger for what your coding agents spend.
home.lede: Skopli is an SDK. It reads the session logs 40 coding-agent harnesses already write to disk, rolls them up, and prices them against market catalogs. One Rust core serves 9 languages under the MIT license, with no account and no telemetry.
home.ledger.caption: `priceRollups` output for the repository's pricing test fixture
home.ledger.note: Token counts are synthetic, from the repository's pricing test fixture, priced at the catalog rates it recorded on {date}. They are not anyone's usage.
home.ledger.totalNote: {priced} priced, {missed} unpriced. The unpriced row is not in the total.
home.layers.h2: Three independent layers. Use any subset.
home.layers.read: Parses local session state into normalized usage events (tokens, sessions, turns, calls), with a diagnostic for every file that would not parse.
home.layers.rollup: Aggregates by model, day (timezone-aware), session, harness, workspace, or block. Input, output, and cache tokens stay in separate buckets.
home.layers.price: Prices each row: `usd` and the catalog that matched, or `priced: false` with the keys it tried. Long-context tiers and cache writes each bill at their own rate.
home.layers.net.price: Fetches OpenRouter, LiteLLM, and models.dev by default, caches them, and works offline from the cache.
home.quick.h2: Four calls from local files to a priced total.
home.quick.p: The same four calls exist in every language, with names adjusted to each language's conventions.
home.quick.link: All 9 languages in the API reference
home.install.p: A C ABI and 8 language facades share one Rust core. A rollup in Python and a rollup in Go return the same total. All packages publish with the first release.
home.harness.h2: 40 harnesses, read where they already write.
home.harness.p: Nothing is installed into the harness: no plugin, no proxy, no exporter. Skopli parses the session state each one keeps on disk. Pass ids as `harnesses` to `readUsage` to read a subset.
home.harness.linkP: The {link} lists what each one records.
home.refuse.h2: Four things it will not do.
home.refuse.guess.dd: An unmatched model returns `priced: false` with the keys it tried, and stays out of the total. The miss shows in the output. A guessed rate would not.
home.refuse.telemetry.dd: Read and Rollup never open a socket. Price fetches public catalogs and sends nothing about you or your usage.
home.refuse.account.dd: There is nothing to sign up for. It is a library you call against files you already have.
home.refuse.double.dd: Input, output, cache read, and cache write are separate columns in every rollup, and misses carry no `usd`.
home.library.p: Skopli ships read, rollup, and price as a library so what you build on top is yours: a dashboard, a nightly report, a CI budget check, a billing reconciliation.
